Summary: Support search by administered-by parameter on InsurancePlan resource
Requirement: "Select products that are administered by the specified organization [using Parameter `administered-by`:`reference` with Expression `InsurancePlan.administeredBy`]"
Context: This search parameter allows querying InsurancePlan resources filtered by the administering Organization reference. The parameter supports multipleAnd (multiple values that must all be true) and multipleOr (comma-separated values where at least one must be true). Allowed chains include: name, partof.
